purpose: IT-01 single registry: classify integration-tests surfaces and expose executable three-tier selectors, prerequisites, assets and safety boundaries. Only suites wired to real containers/channels count as integration evidence; literal/simulated stubs remain scaffold and disabled.

CONTAINER_GATED_REAL_INTEGRATION.meaning: extends AudioVideoContainerBase; IntegrationImagesCondition reports an honest skip when GH-90000 service images are absent

STUB_SCAFFOLD_DISABLED.meaning: literal-constant assertions, Map.of fixtures or simulated local calls with no real service/container/channel interaction; @Disabled until replaced by a wired suite — not evidence

perModuleIntegrationSurfaces.note: outside the integration-tests module; owned by their packages

prerequisites: JDK/Gradle runtime; no Docker or external service is required by the selected local fixture tests
profiles.assets: In-memory maps, literal request values, test-authored bytes, and generated J03 strings; no model weights or licensed media are bundled.
profiles.safety: Harness state is process-local and cleared by MediaTestHarness.close(); use synthetic tenant/principal identifiers only. Process tests use temporary PID files and terminate their child process.
profiles.evidenceLimit: MediaTestHarness, MediaProviderJobLifecycleE2ETest, and MediaPdp3BusinessRecordingIT use simulated/local state. Their integration-named selectors are not proof of a real provider, database, object store, capture, or model effect.

prerequisites: No external prerequisite; classes carry an explicit IT-01 @Disabled scaffold reason
profiles.assets: Literal values and local/synthetic fixtures only; no licensed model or source assets are bundled.
profiles.safety: Scaffolds are disabled and must stay so until wired to actual services/containers/channels. Their names do not make them runnable integration evidence.
profiles.evidenceLimit: The two listed selectors are disabled and execute zero scaffold assertions. EndToEndWorkflowTest.java, ErrorScenarioIntegrationTest.java, LoadTest.java, and PerformanceIntegrationTest.java also remain disabled scaffolds but lack @Tag(integration), so the integration task excludes them even when passed with --tests.

profiles.assets: WAV-shaped bytes are generated in test code; provider work uses the local fixture profile. No licensed corpus or model is bundled.
profiles.safety: A unique in-memory H2 database and per-test LocalStack bucket are used; the test stops the server/runtime and Testcontainers after each run. No customer data or real AWS credentials are required.
profiles.evidenceLimit: Exercises the real Media launcher and HTTP path against isolated H2/LocalStack. H2 does not establish PostgreSQL-engine behavior; LocalStack does not establish AWS production behavior or provider quality.

prerequisites: For the child-JVM metrics variant also select ./gradlew :services:media:integration-tests:postgresWorkflowProcessRestart
profiles.assets: Synthetic jobs, metadata, and in-test byte payloads; no licensed model/source assets are bundled.
profiles.safety: Containers, schemas, buckets, and keys are test-scoped; generated names are isolated. Never point these tests at the active legacy Media store.
profiles.evidenceLimit: Proves the selected PostgreSQL/LocalStack scenarios only; it does not cover every production database, AWS service, provider, or runtime deployment.

profiles.assets: Synthetic WAV-shaped bytes and fixture provider responses; not a real model/source corpus.
profiles.safety: Uses an isolated PostgreSQL container and synthetic test identities; does not dispatch to an external provider.
profiles.evidenceLimit: Exercises commit fencing and transcript state transitions, not transcription quality, voice rights, or a live provider effect.

prerequisites: independently verified rights for model and source audio
profiles.assets: The repository contains no Whisper profile, WAV corpus, or gold transcript for this selector. The referenced environment paths must point to separately reviewed assets; their presence alone does not prove rights.
profiles.safety: Do not copy private/customer source into the repository or test reports. The test creates a local TLS S3 stub, a temporary keystore, and PostgreSQL state; it does not require real AWS credentials.
profiles.evidenceLimit: The test skips when any external input is absent. A run can exercise local inference/readback but does not itself establish model licensing, source rights, independent quality acceptance, or hosted qualification.

resources: STT and TTS service images selected by AUDIO_VIDEO_STT_IMAGE and AUDIO_VIDEO_TTS_IMAGE
prerequisites: both image variables set to owner-pinned image digests for a qualification run
profiles.assets: Compose defaults are mutable :latest tags; no service image, model, voice, or licensed media asset is bundled or admitted by this repository.
profiles.safety: The bounded probes run docker compose run without service-port publication and attempt project cleanup. Use only disposable candidate images and record image digest/host/version externally.
profiles.evidenceLimit: These suites assert typed startup refusal for currently non-admitted providers. A passing refusal probe is not a successful STT/TTS operation or provider qualification; absent images are skipped by IntegrationImagesCondition.

unrepresentedSourceAreas.reason: This mock-based suite has no @Tag(integration), so :services:media:integration-tests:test excludes it even when passed with --tests.

EndToEndWorkflowTest.java, ErrorScenarioIntegrationTest.java, LoadTest.java, and PerformanceIntegrationTest.java are disabled scaffolds without @Tag(integration), so the configured integration task cannot select them.

Separate module :services:media:modules:integration-tests, with contract, authenticated STT/TTS, persistence, pipeline, advanced-services, and multimodal RPC tests; not part of the services:media:integration-tests task.

Provider-owned suite, including MediaUploadCrashRecoveryIT.java, MediaDurableWorkerCrashIT.java, MediaSeededQueryPlanIT.java, and MediaAwsPostgresqlRuntimeStateIntegrationTest.java; select through its owning project task.
Observability-owned instrumentation, tracing, health, alert, metrics, and resource-profile tests; select through :services:media:audio-video-observability.

guards.noTautologyAsIntegration: a test asserting only literals/Map.of fixtures/simulated locals may not carry an Integration/E2E/Load/Journey name without an explicit @Disabled scaffold reason
guards.honestSkip: container-gated suites skip via IntegrationImagesCondition with the missing image names — never silently pass
guards.crosswalkComplete: every *.java file in the integration-tests source tree is classified
